name: Valletta Cruise Port (Grand Harbour)
overview_text: Valletta is the Mediterranean's premier deep natural harbour port. The terminal complex incorporates 17th-century Baroque Pinto Vaults along the picturesque Valletta Waterfront.
getting_around: Walk 600m flat along the waterfront to the Barrakka Lift (€1.00 up, free down) to reach the Upper Barrakka Gardens in central Valletta, or take Bus Route 130 directly to the City Gate Bus Terminus.
all_aboard_warning: Valletta is built on a steep limestone peninsula with a 130-foot elevation climb from the quayside. Using the Barrakka Lift is strongly recommended over the sustained 20-minute uphill walk.

terminals.name: Valletta Cruise Port (Pinto Vaults & Magazino Hall)
terminals.description: Restored 17th-century Baroque storehouse terminal complex offering passenger check-in, customs, duty-free shopping, restaurants, and waterside cafes.

terminals.name: Boiler Wharf Terminal
terminals.description: Secondary deep-water quay for mega-cruise liners with electrified OPS berths.

berths.name: Pinto Wharf (Quays 1-5) & Boiler Wharf
berths.notes: 5 fully electrified berths delivering 64 MW of simultaneous shore-to-ship power for up to 5 vessels concurrently.
berths.source: Transport Malta & Valletta Cruise Port PLC

arrival_procedures: Direct alongside docking inside deep natural Grand Harbour. Passengers step off the gangway directly onto the flat, paved waterfront promenade. Customs and check-in are handled within the historic terminal vaults.
departure_procedures: Streamlined baggage drops and security screenings are handled in Magazino Hall or Pinto Terminal halls. Taxis and local public buses are highly visible directly outside the terminal exit.

walking_feasibility.description: Valletta is built on a high limestone peninsula. Walk 600m flat to the Barrakka Lift (€1.00 up, free down) to reach the Upper Barrakka Gardens in central Valletta. Direct walking without the lift is a 1 km sustained uphill climb (130 ft elevation gain, 20-25 min).

provenance.verification_authority: Valletta Cruise Port PLC & Transport Malta 2026
